title: U.S. House · Massachusetts's 3rd District
area: Northeastern/Merrimack Valley Massachusetts, including Lowell and Lawrence

context.text: Incumbent Lori Trahan advanced from the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed. Gary Grossi is the Republican nominee. Dennis Conlon is running as an Unenrolled (independent) candidate after collecting over 2,200 signatures himself.

priorities.text: Lists key issues including addressing racial injustice, the opioid crisis, climate change, education, gun reform, healthcare, immigration, and women's rights on her official issues page.

positions.summary: Her official healthcare page says she voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, which extends marketplace subsidies for low-income Americans and expands coverage for millions.
positions.quote: She proudly voted to pass the Inflation Reduction Act, which lowers health insurance premiums and expands coverage for millions.

positions.summary: Her official gun reform page says she voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the Assault Weapons Ban Act and the Bipartisan Background Checks Act, and cosponsored the No Guns For Abusers Act.
Her official page says she will always fight for a woman's right to choose and supported the Women's Health Protection Act.
positions.quote: Congresswoman Trahan will always fight for a woman’s right to choose.

positions.summary: In a press release, said she voted against a reconciliation package providing about $70 billion more for ICE and CBP, describing it as funding to expand mass deportation.
positions.quote: House Republicans handed Donald Trump nearly $70 billion to expand his mass deportation machine.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce, including its Commerce, Manufacturing, and Trade and Health subcommittees, for 2025-2026.

candidates.name: Gary Grossi

priorities.text: Affordability, including energy costs and housing.
priorities.quote: Energy costs are crushing families. Gary will push for affordable, evidence-based energy solutions that lower your bills immediately.

priorities.text: Eliminating waste, fraud and abuse in government.
priorities.quote: Expose and eliminate waste, fraud, and abuse at every level of government.

priorities.text: Term limits with mandatory end-of-tour audits.
priorities.quote: Support term limits with mandatory end-of-tour audits.

candidates.researchNotes: His campaign issues page lists general themes (affordability, safe communities, government transparency, defending rights). His housing line is recorded as a statement because it refers to regulations generally, not zoning; his Second Amendment and law-enforcement lines were left out as not directly on the guide's gun-law and police-funding statements.

statements.quote: Stop unrealistic regulations that drive up housing costs and limit supply.
statements.context: On his campaign Issues page, under "Housing"

candidates.name: Dennis Conlon

priorities.text: "My way is also Finance-Free: I am not taking any money from anyone or any organization ever. Money corrupts politics."
"I am a conservative independent who wants single payer, universal, medicaid for all, whatever you want to call it. ... healthcare is a human right."

positions.summary: Says he supports a single-payer, universal health-coverage system.
positions.quote: I am a conservative independent who wants single payer, universal, medicaid for all, whatever you want to call it.

candidates.researchNotes: No campaign website or other statements found beyond the Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey; Ballotpedia returned a bot challenge on re-check.
